shortDescription: Configures the Db2 Mirror on the source node

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: clone_type
options.description: Indicates the clone is warm clone or cold clone A cold clone requires the setup source node to be shut down during the cloning portion of the setup process. A warm clone allows the setup source node to remain active during the entire Db2 Mirror setup and configuration process.

options.name: default_inclusion_state
options.description: The default inclusion state setting will be used when no applicable rules for an object are found in the Replication Criteria List (RCL).

options.name: primary_hostname
options.description: String that contains the host and domain name or IP address of the partition designated as the primary node. IP address is preferred.

options.name: primary_node
options.description: The name of the partition designated as the secondary node. It must be same as the current system name.

options.name: secondary_hostname
options.description: String that contains the host and domain name or IP address of the partition designated as the secondary node. IP address is preferred.

options.name: secondary_node
options.description: The name of the partition designated as the secondary node.

options.name: terminate_confirmed
options.description: A bool value to indicate the terminate mirror action is confirmed. When set to False, only the replication state as NOT_MIRRORED is allowed to run this module. When set to True, this module will execute the terminate mirror without checking the replication state.

options.name: termination_level
options.description: The TERMINATE_MIRROR procedure ends all replication between the primary and secondary nodes and resets the replication state of both nodes to NOT MIRRORED. A clone operation is required to restart replication. When termination_level is RECLONE, all Db2 Mirror configuration information is retained. When termination_level is DESTROY, all Db2 Mirror configuration information is deleted.

options.name: time_server
options.description: String that identifies the DNS name of the NTP server to be added to the configuration. A time server must be used to keep the clocks of the nodes synchronized.
